parameters.name: scale_radius_um
parameters.meaning: scale disc radius in the standard simulation
parameters.source: Hayden 2021 Methods; De Simone 2021 Methods ('a disk 520 um in radius')

parameters.name: source_radius_um
parameters.source: Hayden 2021 Methods ('small off-center circle with a radius of 40 um')

parameters.name: source_offset_um
parameters.meaning: source centre offset toward the anterior margin
parameters.source: De Simone 2021 locate the source 'between the centre and the anterior margin'; the 150 um value is ours

parameters.name: dx_um
parameters.source: Hayden 2021 Methods

parameters.name: dt_h
parameters.source: Hayden 2021 Methods (their code uses 0.005; the step-halving control compares)

parameters.name: growth.measured_linear_slope_per_h
parameters.meaning: MEASURED linear slope of normalised osteoblast area after the Erk peak, d(a/a_peak)/dt (+/-0.002, 68% CI; n=89 cells, 3 scales); before the peak -0.002 +/- 0.002
parameters.source: De Simone 2021 Extended Data Fig. 7b (caption of the figure titled 'Erk activity is required for tissue expansion during zebrafish scale hypertrophy')

parameters.name: growth.rate_after_peak_per_h
parameters.meaning: log-area growth rate used by the code: d ln(a)/dt during the window after each Erk peak (exponential, compounding)
parameters.source: coupling form is ours; its value is taken from growth.measured_linear_slope_per_h

parameters.name: growth.window_h
parameters.meaning: how long a cell grows after each Erk peak
parameters.source: not stated in the text read; chosen as ~one inter-wave interval

parameters.name: growth.peak_threshold
parameters.meaning: Erk level that scores a peak
parameters.source: Hayden 2021 Methods (event scored at prominence > 0.2)

parameters.name: E_T
parameters.source: Hayden 2021: 'We lack experimental data on this parameter' (0.1-1 uM in other cell types)

not_claimed: that a flying fish's scales use these kinetics or parameters (all are zebrafish, regenerating scale)
ontogenetic (first-time) scale development: De Simone 2021 show Erk rings in developing juvenile scales, but the parameters are fitted to regeneration
any microscope image: every picture is a rendering of simulated state
growth feedback on waves, scale mineralisation, scale shape beyond a disc, or overlap/imbrication
living or bioprinted fish feasibility; resin props in artifacts/print are display objects
